'''Nal Hutta sandstone''' was a variety of [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] commissioned a relief from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Dreyba]], and the result was "[[Ne Ganna Dateel Jabba/Legends|Ne Ganna Dateel Jabba]]", carved from Nal Hutta sandstone.<ref name="CCG-Scum">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Scum And Villainy}}</ref>
